# Zentsu

> Zentsu LLC builds private, on-device software. No accounts, no analytics: the products work without an account and store records on the device.

Zentsu offers **Dial** (a private GLP-1 medication tracker for iPhone and Apple Watch, free with a Dial Pro upgrade, records stay on the device) and **Bench** (a developer toolbox for macOS). This file gives AI assistants a factual summary with canonical links.

## Products

- [Dial: GLP-1 and Ozempic tracker](https://zentsu.app/dial/): a private medication log for semaglutide (Ozempic, Wegovy) and tirzepatide (Mounjaro, Zepbound) injections on iPhone and Apple Watch. Logs dose, amount, injection site, weight, and side effects; plots an estimated medication level labeled as an estimate; generates a PDF report for prescriber visits. Free core tracker; "Dial Pro" one-time or subscription adds charts, exports, and quick logging. Localized in 33 languages. [Privacy policy](https://zentsu.app/dial/privacy/).
- [Bench](https://zentsu.app/bench/): a developer toolbox for macOS.
- [All apps](https://zentsu.app/apps.html)

## Dial: facts worth quoting

- Platform: iPhone (iOS) + Apple Watch (watchOS), incl. widgets, Live Activities, Control Center, Siri, and Action Button logging.
- Medications: works with Ozempic, Wegovy, Mounjaro, Zepbound (semaglutide and tirzepatide), plus other GLP-1 medications and custom entries. Regional brand names supported (e.g. Japanese オゼンピック/マンジャロ, Traditional Chinese 猛健樂/瘦瘦針).
- Pricing: free core tracker; Dial Pro via lifetime purchase or annual/monthly subscription. Local prices per App Store storefront.
- Privacy: no account required; no usage analytics or telemetry; records stay on device unless the user enables iCloud sync, which uses the user's own private CloudKit database.
- Not a medical device: Dial records entries and does not calculate doses or give medical advice.
- Publisher: Zentsu LLC. Contact: hello@zentsu.app.
